question:
Refer to the exhibit. A software downgrade must be performed on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switch. What is displayed by running the command shown?
Nexus01# show incompatibility-all system n7000-s2-dk9.8.0.1.bin
options: features that are removed automatically from the switch
that the bootflash file is incompatible with the switch hardware
that the bootflash file is incompatible with the switch software
impact of an in-service software upgrade and chassis reload
theory: Before downgrading NX-OS to an older image, show incompatibility-all system <image> checks the switch's current configuration and enabled features against what the target image actually supports, flagging anything incompatible with the older software that would need to be disabled or would be automatically removed. This is a distinct pre-downgrade sanity check from show install all impact, which specifically evaluates whether a change can be applied as an ISSU versus a disruptive reload — running the incompatibility check before any downgrade or major version change is standard practice to avoid losing configuration unexpectedly or hitting an unsupported feature after the image change. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — Pre-Upgrade/Downgrade Compatibility Checks)
